articles.title: Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India’s deep strikes Inside Pakistan

This account offers crucial insights into India's proactive defence strategies and cross-border operations, vital for understanding contemporary military affairs and strategic decision-making for aspiring officers.

articles.title: 100 hour gap between a vibecoded prototype and a working product
articles.summary: The article reflects on the substantial effort involved in software development, using the term 'vibecoding' to describe the process. The author spent 100 hours on a project, challenging common claims of rapidly building complex apps in minutes. It suggests that such quick builds are often either simple copies of existing projects or result in low-quality outputs, underscoring the significant time investment required for genuine, high-quality development.

articles.title: Russian air defences down 65 drones headed for Moscow, mayor says

This incident highlights ongoing military tensions and active drone warfare tactics between Russia and Ukraine, underscoring the importance of air defence capabilities in modern conflict.
